personalities.label: Cautious trader
personalities.description: Avoids dangerous ports and wants a safe margin; yields cargo to a modest show of force.

personalities.label: Opportunist
personalities.description: Takes any profitable haul, however thin or risky; hard to intimidate.

personalities.label: Bulk hauler
personalities.description: Fills its hold on thin margins along safe lanes; a rich, slow prize.

personalities.label: Loyalist
personalities.description: Trades only in its own faction's and allied space.

personalities.label: Smuggler
personalities.description: Runs dangerous ports for the premium and often slips past raiders.

personalities.label: Corsair
personalities.description: Trades when it must and preys on weaker fleets when it can; never yields easily.
